title: Squares of a Sorted Array
description:
Given an array nums sorted in non-decreasing order, return an array of the squares of its elements, also sorted in non-decreasing order.

Example 1:
Input: nums = [-4,-1,0,3,10]
Output: [0,1,9,16,100]

Example 2:
Input: nums = [-7,-3,2,3,11]
Output: [4,9,9,49,121]

Constraints:
- 1 ≤ len(nums) ≤ 10^4
- -10^4 ≤ nums[i] ≤ 10^4
- nums is sorted in non-decreasing order
idea: The largest square is always at one of the ends of the array. Two pointers from both ends: compare the squares, write the larger one to the end of the result and move that pointer. The answer is filled from right to left.
